]> 04/08/2026 7:31 Fresh snow and more on the way!.

Fresh snow has landed at Perisher! We received a dusting of 3cm overnight, with more forecast to fall throughout the day. Check the Snow Stake to see for yourself!

It's currently -2 degrees in Perisher Valley, with a top of 1 degrees expected, so rug up if you're heading up the mountain today. Expect cloudy skies again, scattered snow showers, and westerly winds of 25 to 35km/h.

Our snowmakers made the most of the cool overnight temperatures, firing up 194 guns from 5:35pm and still running at time of writing, giving Mother Nature a hand topping up the base. Meanwhile, the grooming team have prepared 42 runs with fresh cord, ready for you to carve up.

36 lifts are expected to spin today, though strong winds may affect operations. Keep an eye on the lift report for real-time updates, or download the Perisher App to stay in the loop.

Check back tomorrow to see how much more snow falls today and tonight!
